# Causory

> Causory is Website as a Service (WaaS) for home service businesses — general contractors, HVAC, plumbing, electrical, cleaning, landscaping, roofing, and restoration companies. A one-time setup fee covers custom website design and build; every plan then includes a flat $200/month Website Care Plan for hosting, SSL, security monitoring, daily backups, content updates, and technical support.

Based in San Diego, CA. Serves home service businesses nationwide — the entire process (discovery, design, development, launch) is remote-friendly.

## Plans

- [Pricing](https://causory.com/pricing): Launch ($700 setup + $200/mo), Growth ($1,000 setup + $200/mo, most popular), and Authority ($1,400 setup + $200/mo) — full breakdown of what's included on each tier.
- [Services](https://causory.com/services): what's bundled into every plan — conversion-focused design, fast hosting, built-in SEO, and the AI chatbot add-on included on Authority.
- [Home Services](https://causory.com/home-services): overview for contractors, HVAC, plumbing, electrical, cleaning, landscaping, roofing, and restoration companies, with dedicated pages per trade:
  - [Contractors & Remodelers](https://causory.com/home-services/contractors)
  - [HVAC, Plumbing & Electrical](https://causory.com/home-services/hvac-plumbing-electrical)
  - [Cleaning, Landscaping & Maintenance](https://causory.com/home-services/cleaning-landscaping)
  - [Roofing & Restoration](https://causory.com/home-services/roofing-restoration)
